messages:
jenna.ops: FYI - we're seeing a spike of 5xx errors for vector-write requests in eu-west1. Customers hitting vector-store write APIs may see transient failures. Investigating now, paging oncall. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2945123456

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. Seeing write latency climb ~x6 and error rate ~12% for /v1/vector/write in eu-west1. Spinning up extra write workers and validating disk IO.

deploy-bot: Rollback of recent vectorstore write optimization completed on cluster eu-west1-prod-a. Command: `deploy rollback vectorstore-write-optim 2026-03-23T09:12Z`

mateo.eng: Confirming rollback rolled back the batching experiment (PR #4821). I also throttled the new async-write path via FF `vector_write_async=false`.

sre-oncall: After rollback and throttling, error rate down to ~3%. Still elevated but most customer traffic is succeeding. Continuing to monitor Nginx 5xxs and disk latency.

elaine.cs: Support has the list of affected customers (top 8) and outreach templates. I'll send customer notifications with the current status link and estimated ETA for full recovery.

jenna.ops: Thanks. Status page updated to "degraded" with mitigations noted. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2945123456/status. Please add any customer-facing notes to the status page if needed.

mateo.eng: Opening a follow-up ticket to add backpressure + circuit breaker to the vector writer and a canary for batch size changes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7192

status-bot: STATUS PAGE UPDATED by jenna.ops -> https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2945123456 (impact: Partial outage — write errors in eu-west1; mitigations: rollback, throttling, worker scale-up).

jenna.ops: Current impact: host API customers using vector write in eu-west1; Dedicated and Private deployments unaffected. Mitigation: rollback + throttling + extra workers. Next update in 30m or sooner if anything changes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mateo.eng: Quick log snippet for context:
```
[2026-03-23T09:08:10Z] vector-writer: write_batch: size=2048 latency=812ms err=EIO
[2026-03-23T09:09:02Z] kv-disk: queue_depth=230 lat=1200ms
```

elaine.cs: Draft customer note ready. Will send after one more check that errors remain <5%.

jenna.ops: Closing the active alert channel and moving to monitoring mode. If you see any regression ping here or DM SRE. Postmortem owner: mateo.eng. ETA for postmortem draft: EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
